detail: Chromium, lead, zinc and copper are shown as context only and are not scored. BDL means very low, not zero.

title: Units are assumed
detail: The reports print no units. The organisers assumed the standard unit for each test (mg/l for DO and BOD; none for pH).

title: Standard used: CPCB class B (outdoor bathing)
detail: Class B (outdoor bathing) is the yardstick chosen for this tool. Readings are compared with its limits only; no health conclusions are drawn.

title: Past readings are from lake-side ghats
detail: 2026 immersion is meant to use tanks/kunds; NGT directions bar immersion in Upper and Lower Lake. 2023-2025 readings may not describe the new set-ups.

title: 2026 list is from a press report
detail: The designated list is the Ganesh 2026 list reported by Free Press Journal (22 Sep 2026; article URL still to be added). The Durga 2026 list may differ - verify with BMC.
